description: A clock counting hours, minutes and seconds that fires six events, each with its own start time and length, gates and triggers

params.text: Returns the elapsed time to zero
Lit, that event fires again at every multiple of its start time; unlit, it fires once
Sets the hours part of the elapsed time at which that event starts
Sets the minutes part of the elapsed time at which that event starts
Sets the seconds part of the elapsed time at which that event starts
Sets the hours part of how long that event lasts; with all three length knobs at zero the event runs until a reset
Sets the minutes part of how long that event lasts; with all three length knobs at zero the event runs until a reset
Sets the seconds part of how long that event lasts; with all three length knobs at zero the event runs until a reset

inputs.text: A trigger switches the clock between running and stopped
A trigger returns the elapsed time to zero
A trigger switches that event between enabled and disabled

outputs.text: A trigger when that event starts
A trigger when that event ends
A gate while that event is running
A gate while that event is not running
A gate while the clock is running
A trigger when the clock is reset
A trigger when the clock stops

notes: the clock counts only while it is running, and an event fires nothing until that event is enabled
menu: Reset on Stop fires a reset whenever the clock goes from running to stopped
Reset at Time Limit fires a reset at the limit and keeps the clock running, and without it the clock stops there
Set Limit sets the time at which the limit falls, and Set Time moves the elapsed time to a chosen point
Reset to Enabled Snapshot returns every event to the enabled state it had at the last snapshot, and Save Enabled Snapshot overwrites that snapshot
